_note: MINERVA Aqawan 1 run OFF-SITE through an SSH tunnel (docs/remote.md): engineering mode, attended, nothing autonomous.
!!! Points at REAL hardware through the tunnel: the robofast servers it names must each be started with --hardware. !!!
Not for the first hardware session (telescope status and small moves only: docs/pwi.md, no supervisor or sequencer).

dome: the robofast Aqawan server on 11113. Run the supervisor only against aqawan1_control.json (full control), never aqawan1_shadow.json (read-only: it cannot close). See the Aqawan caution in docs/remote.md.
safetymonitor, observingconditions: a local weather bridge (sites/minerva/weather.yaml). Off-site, sources it cannot reach read as unknown, so the weather is unsafe and nothing opens.

t1, t2 telescope: the robofast PWI server for that telescope (t1_pwi2.json / t1_pwi4.json listen on 11121, t2 on 11122; run one backend per telescope). camera: ASCOM Remote through the tunnel, 7151 / 7152 (installed; camera 0 is the science camera on each).
port_action: the PWI server's M3 port Action, SelectPort, with a port number or a name from its config's ports (docs/pwi.md).
mode engineering, with its own mode file (modes/aqawan1-remote.json under the data directory) so it never shares the on-site enclosure's mode.
Everything else as sites/minerva/aqawan1.json (its notes say where each value comes from).
name: aqawan1
